sections.title: Documentation & Handover (at the time of handover)
Site Cleanliness & Final (instructions in scope of installer)

items.label: Structural material
items.verify: Mounting structure is Hot-Dip Galvanized Iron (HDGI) or aluminium — not painted mild steel

items.label: Tilt & orientation
items.verify: Panels face true south (N. Hemisphere) at design tilt for max annual generation

items.label: Roof penetrations sealed
items.verify: All anchor points sealed with polyurethane (or equivalent) waterproof sealant

items.label: Panel spacing / self-shading
items.verify: Sufficient inter-row spacing; no self-shading during low-sun hours

items.label: No walking / micro-crack damage
items.verify: Panel glass free of scratches, cracks, snail trails; crews never stepped on modules

items.label: Structure fastened
items.verify: Mounting structure securely fastened to roof/base

items.label: Torque
items.verify: All nuts and bolts tightened to specified torque

items.label: Corrosion protection
items.verify: Corrosion protection / anti-rust applied at cut edges & welds

items.label: Module clamps
items.verify: Correct mid/end clamps used; clamped within manufacturer's clamping zone

items.label: Wind/ballast design
items.verify: Structure design (wind speed, ballast/anchoring) matches local wind zone

items.label: Foundation concreting
items.verify: Concrete (PCC) cast for all foundation legs / base plates; fully set and level

items.label: Conduit protection
items.verify: All DC & AC cables run through rigid UV-resistant PVC (RPVC) or metal conduit

items.label: MC4 connectors
items.verify: Panel-to-panel joins use proper crimped & locked MC4 connectors — no taped joints

items.label: Cable sag / dressing
items.verify: Wiring neatly tied to racking rails with UV-resistant cable ties; no roof contact

items.label: Cable size
items.verify: DC & AC cable sizing correct for current & voltage-drop limits

items.label: DC string polarity
items.verify: String polarity verified correct (no reverse connections)

items.label: Cable labelling
items.verify: Strings, DC+/-, AC phases and earth conductors clearly labelled

items.label: Colour coding
items.verify: Conductor colour coding follows standard (earth green/green-yellow, etc.)

items.label: DC-side earthing
items.verify: Panel frames & mounting structure earthed (separate earth line)

items.label: AC-side earthing
items.verify: Inverter casing & distribution boxes earthed (separate earth line)

items.label: Earth resistance
items.verify: Earth resistivity measured with tester

items.label: SPDs fitted
items.verify: Surge Protection Devices present in DCDB & ACDB to protect inverter

items.label: MCBs / MCCBs
items.verify: Correctly rated breakers to isolate power under fault

items.label: DCDB present
items.verify: Dedicated DC Distribution Box installed, IP-rated, UV-protected

items.label: ACDB present
items.verify: Dedicated AC Distribution Box installed, IP-rated

items.label: Lightning arrestor
items.verify: Lightning arrestor installed & earthed (if in design scope)

items.label: MC4 crimping
items.verify: MC4 connectors properly crimped, locked and UV-protected

items.label: DC isolator
items.verify: DC isolator installed and functional (isolates array on demand)

items.label: AC isolator
items.verify: Proper AC isolator installed between inverter and grid/load

items.label: Location & ventilation
items.verify: Inverter in shaded, well-ventilated area; not in direct sun / enclosed heat

items.label: Mounting
items.verify: Inverter firmly wall-mounted at correct height with clearance around it

items.label: Production check
items.verify: At clear-sky noon, output is 70–80% of rated capacity (after losses)

items.label: Anti-islanding test
items.verify: Switch off grid breaker — inverter shuts down within seconds

items.label: Utility settings configured
items.verify: Inverter grid/protection settings configured as per utility (DISCOM) requirements

items.label: Starts without alarms
items.verify: Inverter powers up and starts without alarms; generation verified

items.label: No fault / error codes
items.verify: Inverter display shows no active fault, fault or warning codes

items.label: Grid parameters
items.verify: Grid voltage & frequency within window; inverter syncing normally

items.label: Monitoring / RMS live
items.verify: Remote monitoring (RMS/app/Wi-Fi/GSM) commissioned and reporting data

items.label: Net-meter / bidirectional
items.verify: Net / bidirectional meter installed and recording import & export

items.label: Open Circuit Voltage (Voc)
items.verify: String Voc measured and recorded; matches expected design value

items.label: Short Circuit Current (Isc)
items.verify: String Isc measured and recorded; matches expected design value

items.label: Insulation Resistance (IR)
items.verify: IR (megger) test on DC & AC circuits passed

items.label: Earth continuity
items.verify: Earth continuity test passed across all bonded parts
